message.content: {"brief_rationale":"The doctor recognized the high-risk premature neonatal discharge context, repeatedly screened and acted on current status, gave clear emergency thresholds, repaired follow-up responsibility with specific locations/timing, and maintained medication boundaries. The trajectory achieved safe executable closure with family teach-back and later outpatient/return-home plans, while leaving only acceptable residual uncertainty about exact historical values.
